blocks.raw: SMS enables organizations to send timely and personalized text messages to their customers. These messages can be used for a variety of purposes, including promotional campaigns, service notifications, and transactional alerts such as OTPs and order confirmations.
blocks.text: SMS enables organizations to send timely and personalized text messages to their customers. These messages can be used for a variety of purposes, including promotional campaigns, service notifications, and transactional alerts such as OTPs and order confirmations.

blocks.raw: For organizations operating in India, SMS communication is governed by TRAI's DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology) regulations. To comply with these regulations, organizations must complete the following steps:
blocks.text: For organizations operating in India, SMS communication is governed by TRAI's DLT (Distributed Ledger Technology) regulations. To comply with these regulations, organizations must complete the following steps:

blocks.raw:
* Register as an entity on a DLT platform
* Register and get approval for sender IDs (also known as headers)
* Register message templates under one of the three approved categories:
  * Promotional
  * Service Explicit
  * Service Implicit\
    For more information refer to <Anchor label="Create SMS Template for Indian Orgs (as per TRAI Regulations)" target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/configure-sms-template-content#create-sms-template-for-indian-orgs-as-per-trai-regulations">Create SMS Template for Indian Orgs (as per TRAI Regulations)</Anchor> documentation.

blocks.raw: For non-Indian organizations, the process is simpler, involving direct content creation without DLT compliance. blocks.raw: Engage+ provides a centralized interface for managing SMS templates and campaigns. Key features include:
blocks.text: Engage+ provides a centralized interface for managing SMS templates and campaigns. Key features include:

blocks.raw:
* Uploading and managing DLT-approved SMS templates
* Personalizing messages using dynamic labels and Liquid syntax
* Tracking user interactions via link tracking
* Monitoring delivery performance and message failures through analytics and reporting tools
